connect.foreign: This printer belongs to an earlier BamDude connection. Choose the printer again in the device list.
connect.setup: BamDude has no usable connection. Open the BamDude tab to check its settings.
connect.restart: OrcaSlicer has not allowed this BamDude server yet. The BamDude tab says how to allow it.
connect.refused: The BamDude server refused the connection. Check the API key in the BamDude tab.

action.queue_manual: Add to the queue, start by hand
action.library_only: Only put it in the library

filament.pinned: The slots chosen in OrcaSlicer (this plate only)

warning.vibration_cali_unsupported: Vibration calibration is not supported by BamDude and is not sent.
warning.filament_unconfirmed: OrcaSlicer chose slots the printer's current state does not show, so they cannot be kept. BamDude can choose the filament instead.

send.library: {file} is in the BamDude library. Nothing was queued.
send.partial: BamDude queued only part of {file}. Open BamDude to see what was refused.
send.unknown: BamDude has not confirmed {file} yet. The plugin will check again; do not send it twice.
send.cancelled: Sending {file} was cancelled. Nothing new was queued.
send.confirmed: BamDude confirmed {file}: it is in the queue.
send.not_received: BamDude never received {file}, so nothing was queued. The BamDude tab's history can send it again.

reason.plate_ambiguous: the file does not hold the plate OrcaSlicer named. Slice again and send once more.
reason.not_sliced: the file holds no sliced plate.
reason.host_version: this OrcaSlicer version is not supported for sending. Monitoring still works.
reason.not_permitted: the API key may not do this. The BamDude tab names the missing right.
reason.connector_disabled: the connector is switched off on the BamDude server.
reason.hash_mismatch: the server received different bytes than the plugin sent. Nothing was queued.
reason.upload_busy: another upload did not finish in time. Try again.
reason.no_plates: no plate was chosen for the queue.
reason.copies: the number of copies is outside what the server allows.
reason.too_many_jobs: too many jobs in one send.
reason.filament: this filament choice cannot be sent to this target.
reason.option_not_for_autoqueue: the AutoQueue cannot keep a nozzle offset calibration choice.
reason.option: OrcaSlicer chose a value of "{option}" the plugin does not know.
reason.foreign: this printer belongs to an earlier BamDude connection. Choose it again in the device list.
reason.stale: BamDude has not heard from this printer recently.
reason.too_large: the file is larger than the server accepts.
reason.source_changed: OrcaSlicer changed the file while it was copied. Send again.
reason.disk_error: the plugin could not copy the file.
reason.timeout: the server did not answer in time.
reason.connect: the server could not be reached.
reason.tls: the server's certificate was not accepted.
reason.redirect: the server answered with a redirect. Enter the final address in the BamDude tab.
reason.protocol: the server's answer was not understood.
reason.rejected: BamDude refused every plate. Open BamDude to see why.
reason.journal_busy: the plugin's history is busy (another OrcaSlicer window may be closing). Try again in a moment.
reason.journal: the plugin could not write its history, so nothing was sent.
reason.context_changed: the server's records belong to another connection now.
reason.receipt_compacted: the result is too old to be read again.
reason.not_received: the server never received the request.
reason.foreign_namespace: this record belongs to an earlier server or key and is never sent again.
reason.nothing_to_resume: there is nothing to go on with.
reason.nothing_to_send: there is nothing to send again.
reason.operation_not_found: the server no longer knows this send.
reason.setup: BamDude has no usable connection. Open the BamDude tab to check its settings.
reason.export_token_unknown: the file list is out of date. Refresh it and choose the file again.
reason.export_token_used: this file was already sent from the list. Refresh it to send again.
reason.export_token_expired: the file list is out of date. Refresh it and choose the file again.
reason.export_token_stale: the connection or the export folder changed. Refresh the list.
reason.export_missing: the file is gone from the export folder.
reason.export_not_a_file: the export folder holds a link or something other than a file there.
reason.export_outside_root: the file leads outside the export folder and is not sent.
reason.export_changed: the file changed after it was listed. Refresh the list.
